fields.note: The Uzbek season article states the closing day outright: 3 December 2026 (the English article still shows 'Dates 27 February – till now', which is why the asset left the end null). Its table is updated to 15 November 2026 with all 16 teams on 27 matches of 30 rounds, so a 3 December finish is consistent.

UZ2L is the Pro League (second tier); the asset's 11-29 came from the Super League, not this page. The Uzbek article dates the season 5 April - 30 November 2026, which is the day recorded. Caveat: its table already looks final (182 matches, 14 teams, 26 rounds, winners Aral, updated 9 November 2026), and round 26 fixture boxes are dated 9 November 2026 with one box carrying 2026-12-31, so the stated 30 November close may not be the actual last match day - hence medium, not high.
